documents.title: Enterprise Privacy at OpenAI
documents.text: Enterprise Privacy at OpenAI. Training: We do not use business data from ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Team, or the OpenAI API to train our models. Consumer plans (Free and Plus) may be used to improve models unless the user opts out in Data Controls. Data residency: Enterprise customers can choose data residency at rest in the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Japan, Canada, South Korea, Singapore, or Australia. Retention: Enterprise workspace data is deleted within 30 days after contract termination or within 30 days of a deletion request. Our Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is published at openai.com/policies/data-processing-addendum.

documents.text: Anthropic Commercial Privacy & Data Terms. Training: Anthropic does not train Claude models on prompts or outputs from Claude for Work (Team and Enterprise) or the commercial API. Consumer Free and Pro chats are not used for training unless the user explicitly opts in or submits feedback. Data regions: Customer content is stored in the United States and European Union regions. Retention: Commercial prompts and outputs are retained for 30 days by default (or zero-data-retention for eligible API customers) and deleted within 30 days of contract termination or written deletion request. Our Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is published and incorporated into Commercial Terms.

Our Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is published at freshworks.com/data-processing-addendum/.
